title: Transfer Charges, Transfer Shrink and Grain Bank Return Ratios by Programme
content:
Stored bushels sometimes move from a storage agreement onto a marketing contract, and grain deposited on a bank account comes back as finished product at a ratio the programme fixes. This page posts the three figures for the six programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The provision

Where stored bushels are transferred onto a marketing contract the programme fixes the shrink taken on the transfer, as a percentage, and the charge raised for each bushel transferred. Where the programme returns finished product against bushels deposited, it fixes the bushels of product returned for each bushel deposited.

## Posted figures

| Programme | Transfer shrink (percent) | Transfer charge (USD per bushel) | Product returned for each bushel deposited |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.0 | 0.0000 | 1.00 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.5 | 0.0100 | 0.96 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.0 | 0.0100 | 1.00 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.0 | 0.0000 | 1.00 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.0 | 0.0100 | 1.00 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.0 | 0.0200 | 1.00 |

## Notes for the desk

The single programme that takes shrink on a transfer is the Grain Bank Deposit Account, at 0.5 percent; on the other five nothing is taken off the bushels moving across.

The transfer charge is nil on the Open Storage Account and the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement, 0.0100 for each bushel on three programmes, and 0.0200 for each bushel on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.

A return ratio of 1.00 records that a bushel deposited comes back as a bushel of product. The Grain Bank Deposit Account returns 0.96 of a bushel of finished product for each bushel deposited, which is the only ratio in the catalogue below one for one.

## Worked figures, on hypothetical bushels

Eight thousand bushels transferred off a Grain Bank Deposit Account carry shrink of 0.5 percent, which is forty bushels, and a charge of 0.0100 for each bushel transferred, which is 80.00. The same eight thousand bushels transferred off an Identity Preserved Segregated Storage carry no shrink and a charge of 0.0200 for each bushel, which is 160.00.
